vocabulary.meaning: 凉爽的，冷静的，酷的，变凉
生动的，鲜艳的，栩栩如生的，清晰的
电子的，电子设备的，网上的
中心，中心点，集中，（使）注意力集中于

examples.text: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems throughout the body.
examples.translation: 确实，跳绳对健康有许多好处，并会影响全身多个系统。
examples.speechText: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems throughout the body.

examples.text: College professors these days face an ever-higher bar to grab the attention of their students, forced to compete with the pulling power of smartphones and laptops in large lecture halls.
examples.translation: 如今，大学教授要吸引学生的注意力，面临的要求越来越高；在大讲堂里，他们不得不与智能手机和笔记本电脑的吸引力竞争。
examples.speechText: College professors these days face an ever-higher bar to grab the attention of their students, forced to compete with the pulling power of smartphones and laptops in large lecture halls.

examples.text: The huntsman caught only a glimpse of the deer before it ran into the woods.
examples.translation: 那只鹿跑进树林前，猎人只来得及瞥见它一眼。
examples.speechText: The huntsman caught only a glimpse of the deer before it ran into the woods.

examples.text: Any moisture in the air cools（cool的第三人称单数形式） and changes into clouds and rain.
examples.translation: 空气中的水汽冷却后，便形成云和雨。
examples.speechText: Any moisture in the air cools and changes into clouds and rain.

examples.text: Joy on the other hand, is described as a vivid emotion of pleasure.
examples.translation: 另一方面，喜悦被描述为一种鲜明而强烈的愉快情绪。
examples.speechText: Joy on the other hand, is described as a vivid emotion of pleasure.

examples.text: These results must be accurate, because all the calculations have been done by an electronic computer.
examples.translation: 这些结果一定是准确的，因为所有计算都是由电子计算机完成的。
examples.speechText: These results must be accurate, because all the calculations have been done by an electronic computer.

examples.text: Get up with a leisurely yawn and stretch.
examples.translation: 悠闲地打着哈欠、伸着懒腰起床。
examples.speechText: Get up with a leisurely yawn and stretch.

examples.text: His short story, "The Celebrated Jumping Frog of Calaver’s County", was an immediate success and his new life began.
examples.translation: 他的短篇小说《卡拉维拉县著名的跳蛙》一发表就大获成功，他的新生活也由此开始。
examples.speechText: His short story, "The Celebrated Jumping Frog of Calaver’s County", was an immediate success and his new life began.

examples.text: At Lufka Refillable Zero Waste store in Tampa, customers bring in reusable containers to fill with soap, shampoo and cleaning supplies instead of buying products in single-use packaging.
examples.translation: 在坦帕市的Lufka零废弃补充装商店，顾客自带可重复使用的容器来装肥皂、洗发水和清洁用品，而不是购买采用一次性包装的产品。
examples.speechText: At Lufka Refillable Zero Waste store in Tampa, customers bring in reusable containers to fill with soap, shampoo and cleaning supplies instead of buying products in single-use packaging.

examples.text: Avoid touching your face, as hands can introduce viruses.
examples.translation: 避免触摸脸部，因为双手可能把病毒带到脸上。
examples.source: （2025年真题·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: Avoid touching your face, as hands can introduce viruses.

examples.text: Allow things（thing的复数形式） to settle with time.
examples.translation: 让事情随着时间慢慢平息下来。
examples.speechText: Allow things to settle with time.

examples.text: This is the era of women’s liberation.
examples.speechText: This is the era of women’s liberation.

examples.text: Her work has centered（center的过去分词形式） on humpbacks that reproduce near Australia’s Great Barrier Reef.
examples.translation: 她的研究主要围绕在澳大利亚大堡礁附近繁殖的座头鲸展开。
examples.speechText: Her work has centered on humpbacks that reproduce near Australia’s Great Barrier Reef.

examples.text: In the case of the Namib Desert, for example, when it does rain, that rain does not fall in the desert itself but rather in the mountains to the east.
examples.translation: 以纳米布沙漠为例，那里即使下雨，雨也不是下在沙漠本身，而是下在东面的山中。
examples.speechText: In the case of the Namib Desert, for example, when it does rain, that rain does not fall in the desert itself but rather in the mountains to the east.

examples.text: Losers were likely to throw the hand symbol of scissors
examples.translation: 失败者很可能会打出代表剪刀的手势
examples.speechText: Losers were likely to throw the hand symbol of scissors

公亩（面积单位，等于 100 平方米，符号为 a）

砹（极不稳定放射性元素）

（表示有能力做或能够发生）能
catch 的过去式和过去分词（表示抓住、捕捉、赶上、听到、染上（疾病）、发现（某人做某事）等）
被抓住、被捕获、被捕（用于 be caught / get caught 等被动结构）
清洁（clean 的 ing 形式）
做（do 的过去分词形式）
越来越高的：表示某种程度、数量或质量不断提高。
<英，非正式>（说话人）讨厌（或鄙夷）的人
掌控、照管、责任（常与 in 等连用）

jump 的现在分词／动名词：跳
<英，非正式>（尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐

（表示在与已知的人或事物同一类中）另外
使（腿）作剪式运动（scissor 的第三人称单数形式）
供应（supply 的第三人称单数）
坦帕市（美国佛罗里达州西部港市）
（引导名词性从句，本身无实义，常略去不译）

更加（用于比较级，最高级前）
这（指前面曾提及或暗指的人或物）
这（指当前所处的地方或时间）

把握（击球、射门等）的时机
至于（亦用于固定短语 as touching）
感动（touch 的现在分词形式）

用树木覆盖（wood的第三人称单数）
